column1: # One banner per line: BANNER<TAB>EXPECTED (empty EXPECTED means "no version").
# Both version readers -- bin/ai-provider-version (Unix, used by the wrappers and
# the Bash installer) and Get-ReportedProviderVersion (the Windows installer) --
# must agree on every line. A disagreement would qualify a build on one platform
# and refuse it on the other.
